statusGroups.reason: ADRs 0033/0038/0095: static Input queries and native SDL channel enable/sample lifetime execute with numeric Vector3 values and typed JoyMotionCalibration. Manual stationary bias, gravity filtering, disabled/focus zeros, mapping/ID retirement, errors and scene motion have public/native Linux Wayland checks. The independent 616-step C++ trace and prepared 0/0 owner/all-thread managed gates pass. Public and positive SDL/native strict NativeAOT checks also pass; full regression, hardware/mobile/foreign execution and native allocator limits are recorded separately in docs/components/gamepad-motion.md.

ADRs 0033/0038/0095: manual device values are copied unchanged into four independent retained fields under the Input lock. Setters work on any thread, including during Engine execution, without a display, controller, input-event synthesis or hardware activation. Public tests cover exact floating-point bits, copies, concurrent snapshots and actual Entity consumers; current verification limits are in docs/components/device-sensors.md.

Typed copied snapshots, zero defaults and the complete manual override path execute through the public API and headless Engine/SceneTree/Entity consumer. Native automatic device acquisition is absent: the exact prerequisite is the owning Android/iOS sensor host adapter, capabilities/project settings/permissions, acquisition and delivery/retirement lifecycle for accelerometer, gravity, gyroscope and magnetometer. These getters must consume that producer in its first complete mobile sensor slice. Desktop manual verification does not establish hardware delivery; see docs/components/device-sensors.md.
